_note: V7 NEUTRAL SHARED N-PLAYER board (3–6) for build_board.py --type regionmap. Data is the source of truth. RENDER REBUILT (bg-infodesign 2026-08): render_regionmap now draws the ONE neutral any-seat board — no 2p across-the-table mirror, no per-edge clock rails. The clock is DECK-DRIVEN (the 開團 Booking deck IS the clock): a full-width clock band carries the DAY deck (out → 黃昏 DUSK → flip to night), the NIGHT deck (out → 末班車 LAST TRAIN → finish round, end), and the shared FACE-UP Booking row — NO numbered vendor-claims track. The 4-region diamond (北 top · 中 left · 東 right · 南 bottom) carries colour + emblem + 繁體 (dual-coded), each with its FACE-UP vendor card slots (card-exact footprints; slots_n below is the 4p HOME default, per-count scaling in the setup table) + a MARKET deck; ingredients are CARDS in those market decks (components/ingredients.csv), so there is NO ingredient-supply section. The HSR spine runs N↔S with a region STOP at each end. hsr_closed_marker draws the 停 Scheduled-Maintenance EVENT as a printed LABEL on the track (the event card is played ONTO the track) — NOT a separate dashed drop-slot (CD steer 2026-08). Bottom band: PER-COLOUR Follower supply trays (each player's own pool — no shared table pool) + Trending markers, a how-to-read legend, and the per-count setup table. Two states via --phase day|night (warm gold day / neon night chrome; region colours stay warm in both). Styled to match the character/player-board house hand (inner gold hairline frame, coloured header banners, drawn emblems) — NOT the retired soft-watercolour AI map mock-up. Per-count booking-deck + (V7-M tightened, slow-refill) vendor-slot tables + the per-colour follower supply below are DATA. Region colours: night-market (identity.md), CVD-checked.
title: Travel Agents: Taiwan — the table (V7 · 3–6 players)

clock_model.driver: the finite VENDOR pools — the day pool (13) then the night pool (11) deplete; the phase ends when its pool is exhausted. NOT the Booking deck.
clock_model.dusk: 黃昏 DUSK — fires when the DAY vendor pool is exhausted (all day vendors claimed or sold out, deck empty, no day stall in play) — finish the turn, flip to night.
clock_model.last_train: 末班車 LAST TRAIN — fires when the NIGHT vendor pool is exhausted — finish the round, then end.
clock_model.retired: the vendor-claims clock, its dusk@/last-train@ thresholds, the +1-on-Bribe step, and the stall backstop are ALL DELETED (§11 canon). ALSO DELETED (§17): the Booking-deck-driven clock and its seeded 黃昏/末班車 boundary cards — superseded by vendor depletion; the Booking deck is now pure tour-supply.

vendor_clock._note: V7-M VENDOR-DEPLETION CLOCK + the CLOSING-TIME DIE (§17, CD refinement 2026-08-10): the finite vendor pools ARE the clock (DUSK = day pool exhausted; LAST TRAIN = night pool exhausted), and the Closing-Time die — the game's FIRST dice/randomness — is the forcing function that thins the board when claiming stalls. It REPLACES the deterministic sell-out cadence.
vendor_clock._track_note: rounds per Closing-Time track cycle, per player count. BASELINE 3 for all counts (one die, one track, no per-count component swap). L is the #1 sim PACING KNOB — sweep L∈{2,3,4} (3p may drop to 2, 6p may rise to 4 — §17.5).
vendor_clock.roll_timing: after round L of the track completes (at end-of-round), roll the Closing-Time die, then reset the track to round 1.
vendor_clock.removal_rule: a region face (N/C/S/E) closes the OLDEST (leftmost) face-up stall in that rolled region — contested or not — it is GONE (never returned to the deck), then run the normal end-of-round refill so the pool net-drains by one. BLANK → nothing (a 1/3 reprieve). Rolled region has no removable face-up stall → nothing (NO reroll).
vendor_clock.followers_home: every follower committed on a die-removed stall — INCLUDING a live contest — returns HOME to its owner's BOARD (kept, no re-grow), per followers-meeples-redesign §2.5. NO resource penalty — this OVERRIDES the old 'contested stalls immune to aging' rail (the die CAN close a stall out from under a live fight; the cost is opportunity + tempo, not lost followers).
vendor_clock.deadlock_backstop: deck empty + face-up static for one full track cycle → fire the boundary (§17.3). Guarantees DUSK / LAST TRAIN still fire even on an all-BLANK streak with zero claims; the die only ever SPEEDS the close, never blocks it.

booking_deck_sizes._rule: DAY = 3·(N+1), NIGHT = 4·(N+1) (SIM-VALIDATED; reconciles §11's earlier N+2 draft to what the sim actually validated). §17: the Booking deck is NO LONGER the clock — it is finite tour-supply and, like the vendor decks, does NOT reshuffle; if a phase's Booking deck empties the face-up row simply stops refilling (drawing tours is optional supply, not the clock). No boundary card is seeded.

follower_supply._rule: V7-M MEEPLES: followers are a PER-PLAYER, per-colour pool — there is NO shared/central table pool (the old shared scaled block is retired). At setup each player takes their character's `max` followers in their OWN colour into a labelled per-colour supply zone by their board; `start_meeples` of them (baseline 2) start ON their board, the rest sit in their supply. A follower is only ever in your supply, on your board, or committed on a stall. `max` enforces the old Followers-max ceiling physically — component count, zero tracking.
follower_supply.setup_line: followers per colour = your character's max (6; 網紅 The Influencer = 8). Draw them from your colour's bin; put 2 on your board, the rest in your supply.

legend_notes: SLOW REFILL (scarcity): a claimed or cleared vendor slot stays EMPTY; refill all empty slots from the region decks at the END of each round (never immediately).
阿嬤 The Globetrotter — her Travel-anywhere costs 1 follower to her supply (the trip tires her crowd).
Win a contested stall → your followers on it come home to YOUR BOARD (kept). Lose it → your followers go back to YOUR OWN supply (re-rally them); they never join the winner.

vendor_slots._note: face-up vendor slots per region (N/C/S/E); DAY = NIGHT (one table). V7-M SCARCITY (2026-08): counts tightened to ~1.0-1.33 stalls/agent AND refill is now SLOW (see `refill`). The V7 sim proved the old ~1.5-2.0/agent with IMMEDIATE refill left contested_frac at only 3-5%: claiming a stall instantly conjured a substitute, so opening a contest was -EV. Tighter counts + per-round (not instant) refill remove the cheap substitute and force the crowd-fight. `slots_n` on each region is the 4p HOME default for the render.
vendor_slots.refill: SLOW / per-round: a claimed or cleared slot stays EMPTY; refill ALL empty slots from the region decks at the END of each round (after every player has taken one turn). NEVER immediate. This is the load-bearing scarcity lever - it makes each stall a non-substitutable prize for the rest of the round.

event_deck_mix._note: V7-M EVENT SYSTEM (2026-08, §15.4/§15.6-B): events.csv is the POOL; ingredients.csv fixes each region deck's ingredient cards. At setup, per region+phase, shuffle the matching event pool (rows whose `deck` = <region>-<phase>) and deal this many events into that region's deck; the rest go back to the box. Different mix every game — free replayability. Event pressure rises GENTLY with player count (interaction payoff + faster deck churn under more players); capped so per-player swing stays bounded — night N/E at 6p (~40% events) is the #1 density knob to watch. Scheduled Maintenance / island (board-scope) banners live inside night decks and fire board-scope when drawn — no separate deck.
